title: Clustering and Pruning in Causal Data Fusion
abstract: arXiv:2505.15215v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data fusion, the process of combining observational and experimental data, can enable the identification of causal effects that would otherwise remain non-identifiable. Although identification algorithms have been developed for specific scenarios, do-calculus remains the only general-purpose tool for causal data fusion, particularly when variables are present in some data sources but not others. However, approaches based on do-calculus may encounter computational challenges as the number of variables increases and the causal graph grows in complexity. Consequently, there exists a need to reduce the size of such models while preserving the essential features. translated_title: 因果数据融合中的聚类与剪枝
translated_abstract: 数据融合是将观测数据和实验数据相结合的过程，能够使原本无法识别的因果效应变得可识别。尽管针对特定场景已经开发了一些识别算法，但do-演算仍然是因果数据融合唯一通用的工具，特别是当某些变量仅存在于部分数据源时。然而，随着变量数量的增加和因果图复杂性的增长，基于do-演算的方法可能面临计算上的挑战。因此，需要在保留模型基本特征的同时减小此类模型的规模。为此，我们提出剪枝（移除不必要的变量）和聚类（合并变量）作为因果数据融合的预处理操作。我们将早期针对单一数据源的结果进行了推广，并推导了应用剪枝和聚类的条件。
tldr: 本文提出剪枝与聚类作为因果数据融合的预处理操作，通过移除不必要变量和合并变量来简化复杂因果模型，在保留关键特征的同时降低计算开销，使因果效应的可识别性分析更加高效。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pruning and clustering as preprocessing operations for causal data fusion, simplifying complex causal models by removing unnecessary variables and combining them, thereby reducing computational costs while preserving essential features for identifying causal effects.
